## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Zero invasive risk, full model and neighbor agreement, and validated benign architecture support routine review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 100%, Benign 0%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Zero invasive carcinoma risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (10% alpha, 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 62nd OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image quality, unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (91%–92% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-0.931) [F2], but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.38 contribution) pushes against invasion [F3] (19/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.351 contribution) [F4], caption-inconsistent (18/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.317 contribution) supports benign tissue (20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Benign epithelial fraction** (regions 0, 8, 11) · context · 2% (4th percentile) [F7]; sparse nuclei and wrong-direction validation feature · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in validation (3-region deletion drop 0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197; excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven by deletion (0.0008, CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- A benign lesion mimics Normal (contrast case BACH_0384 is Benign at 89% similarity, differing in duct-confined cells and TILs).
- Sparse epithelium (2% across regions 0, 8, 11) under-samples focal ductal atypia or scant neoplastic nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 8, 11**: Verify normal lobules, tubules, and benign stroma directly (lobule concept is unreliable).
2. **Region 0**: Inspect the 5 HoVer-Net neoplastic-flagged nuclei and highest invasion score (0.23) for artifact.
3. **Regions 4, 6, 9**: Exclude benign ductal proliferation (region 6), lymphocytic infiltrate (region 4), or pleomorphism (region 9).
